text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dang, Suzuka's faster than greased
lightning! I
just couldn't keep up.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But it was real exciting! I had loads of
fun!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Good match today, Taiki.
choice_data_list: That was the best run ever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I might've lost this one, but next time's
gonna be
a whole 'nother story!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well, I don't intend to let go of
the lead.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But you ran incredibly well today. You
were so
powerful... and your speed was
utterly
spellbinding.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ya really think so? That means a lot!
Thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No... I should be the one saying thanks.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I came here to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When we were running, your speed
struck me to
my core...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It helped me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Umm, sure...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If that's how ya feel, then I'm awful glad
I could
help!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But I ain't goin' down next time either!
Where're
ya thinkin' of heading next?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I'm going to Hong Kong.
There's
something I don't want to lose
sight of.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Are you for real?! That's some grit
you've got!
You're somethin' else,
Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That means I won't see you for a while.
What are
your plans, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I'm gonna keep running in more
and more
races. I wanna see how fast I
can go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, the Mile Championship draws
to a
close.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Such overwhelming speed...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But... I'll get there one day!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I just got off the phone with my folks!
They were
tickled pink at the good
news!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But the real surprise is still to come!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: When I become Umamusume of the Year, they'll be in for even more of a treat!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout it, Trainer? You think I did
well enough
to be Umamusume of the
Year?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think she's done all she can possibly do
as a
sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But there's no denying that there are
other
Umamusume who have done
exceptionally well
this past year...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I don't think I can handle the
suspense!
choice_data_list: Let's wait for the announcement in...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But training's sure to take my mind off
things! If I
just keep on runnin',
January'll be here quick as a
wink!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I've got more running to do till
I'm
Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue training diligently for the
upcoming Yasuda Kinen, awaiting the
announcement of the
next Umamusume
of the Year...
